headerDisplay: Adds ecobee Smart Security to Apple Home: arm Stay or Away, disarm, and see alarms. Unofficial. It uses the same ecobee cloud as the ecobee app.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name shown in the Home app.

refreshToken.title: Refresh token
refreshToken.description: Filled in when you sign in. You only need a new one if ecobee signs the plugin out, for example after a password change.

homeId.title: Home ID
homeId.description: Only needed if your account has more than one home. The log lists your homes.

offerNight.title: Offer Night
offerNight.description: Adds a Night mode to use in automations. ecobee has no Night mode, so Night arms Stay. Changing this recreates the security system in the Home app, so you need to set up its scenes and automations again.

alarmTrigger.title: Enter Triggered State
alarmTrigger.description: Immediately: as soon as a door or sensor trips while armed, like the ecobee app. After the entry delay: only if no one disarms in time, so automations don't run while you walk in. Smoke alarms always trigger immediately.

smokeSensor.title: Smoke sensor
smokeSensor.description: Adds a Smoke Alarm accessory that detects smoke when ecobee reports a smoke alarm. Use it for Home app notifications and automations.

allowHolds.title: Allow security holds
allowHolds.description: Lets other Homebridge plugins, like a robot vacuum, keep the system from arming Away while they work: if it's armed Away it's switched to Stay, and Away comes back when they're done. Away asked for in the Home app meanwhile waits until they're done. Each plugin also has to be allowed in holdPlugins (the settings page lists the ones that asked). See "Security holds" in the README.

holdPlugins.title: Plugins allowed to ask for holds
holdPlugins.description: Package names of the plugins that may ask, or the name a plugin asks with if it gives no package. With no list, all plugins may ask while Allow security holds is on.

armAwayNowSwitch.title: Arm Away Now switch
armAwayNowSwitch.description: Adds an Arm Away Now switch to the Home app (with Allow security holds on). Turning it on arms Away now, with the normal exit delay, and sends any robots that are out back to their base (a robot that can't make it in time stops where it is). Away from the security tile, scenes, automations and Siri waits until robots are done instead.

robotReturnSeconds.title: Extra time for robots to get home (seconds)
robotReturnSeconds.description: If Away is armed while a robot is out, the countdown waits up to this much longer for it to get back to its base, and arms as soon as it's docked. 0: no waiting.

airQuality.title: Air quality sensors
airQuality.description: Adds 2 sensors for each ecobee Premium thermostat: air quality (with VOC) and CO2. ecobee's own HomeKit integration doesn't include them. Updates every 5 minutes.

co2Alert.title: CO2 alert level (ppm)
co2Alert.description: At or above this level, the CO2 sensor reports abnormal CO2. Use it for notifications and automations, like turning on ventilation.
